name: Frame
description: Connect letters around the box to form words

rules.title: How to Play
rules.rule1: Form words using the 12 letters on the box sides
rules.rule2: Consecutive letters must be from different sides
rules.rule3: Each new word starts with the last letter of the previous word

invalidLetter: Use only letters on the board.
sameSide: Choose a letter from a different side.
wrongStart: Start with the last letter of the previous word.
rejected: That chain wasn’t accepted. Edit it and try again.
dictionaryUnavailable: Word list couldn’t load. Try again.
